code_format: timesaver.gg / wowsims talents string: trees in the order of "trees", joined with "-"; within a tree one digit (the rank) per talent in codeOrder (row by row, left to right); trailing zeros of each tree and trailing dashes are dropped. Example: -055-5530003315513151

rules.tier: a talent in row N (1-based) needs 5 x (N-1) points in its tree; client TraitCond SpentAmountRequired matches 5 x (N-1) for all 467 nodes. Whether points in the gated row itself count (Method.gg planner) or only rows above (wowsims) is not settled by the client data.
rules.prereq: prerequisite at its maximum rank (wowsims ui/sim/talents/broken_talents.ts rule; client TraitEdge Type 2/3 gives the link, not the rank)

sources.client: Forever client DB2 tables TraitTree, TraitNode, TraitNodeEntry, TraitNodeXTraitNodeEntry, TraitDefinition, TraitDefinitionEffectPoints, TraitEdge, TraitCond, CurvePoint, Spell, SpellEffect, SpellName, SkillLineAbility, SpellClassOptions, build 1.60.1.70862 (wago.tools CSV export, fetched 2026-11-08). These exports carry no hotfixes.
